credentialLeak.evidence: No committed/runtime credential value or secret-bearing API/UI schema was found; .env is ignored and absent in this evaluation workspace.

executionSurface.evidence: The generated OpenAPI allowlist contains exactly eight GET routes; source scans found no placement, modification, cancellation, smart-order, or private NATS call in application code.

runtimeFixtureFallback.evidence: Runtime source contains no contract-fixture import/path and runtime Docker COPY allowlists exclude tests and fixtures.

falseLive.evidence: A local regression set the required spot quote source_at to 120 seconds old while all heartbeats remained healthy; GET /api/v1/system/status returned LIVE.

scores.rationale: Secrets use secret types and storage-key rejection, worker-only Groww environment/tmpfs boundaries are declared, OpenAPI/UI are GET-only, and no broker mutation call was found. Container enforcement is not locally verified.

Segmented pagination, reconciliation ordering, calendar blocking, and event-age rejection exist, but required quote freshness is absent from readiness/global status and the silent-feed branch exits instead of using the bounded reconnect loop.

Universe selection, event-time one-minute candles, finalized five-minute aggregation, late/duplicate handling, SQL idempotency, Redis TTLs, and rebuild logic are implemented and unit-tested; real PostgreSQL/Redis execution is blocked.

Eight endpoints, localhost bindings, five-service topology, status-first responsive dashboard, source timestamps, accessible tables/status text, and operating docs exist; Compose is unverified and UI separator glyphs are visibly mojibaked.

All available unit/contract/static/frontend checks pass and blocked gates are explicit and runnable, but the suite misses the reproduced false-LIVE case, Docker integration is skipped, live tests are skipped, and the fresh-stack five-minute acceptance timing is unreliable.

findings.summary: Readiness and global status never evaluate required quote source timestamps.
findings.evidence: readiness() reads heartbeats, subscription, and account only; status() returns LIVE when those values are healthy. Worker._store_market() marks market HEALTHY without applying the 15-second quote threshold. A 120-second-old spot quote reproduced LIVE locally.
findings.action: Evaluate the subscribed spot and future source_at values against quote_stale_seconds during an open session before readiness/status can be LIVE, fail the market endpoint closed for stale required quotes, and add the reproduced regression test.

findings.summary: The explicit feed-silence path exits Worker.run instead of reconnecting with bounded backoff.
findings.evidence: except FeedRestartRequired records STALE and immediately re-raises outside the worker loop; only other exceptions reach the reconnect wait at lines 612-624.
findings.action: Route FeedRestartRequired through the existing reconnect branch and add a runnable worker-loop test proving silence produces STALE, cleanup, bounded wait, and resubscription without ending run().

findings.summary: A fresh open-market stack can fail the live gate before five complete source minutes exist.
findings.evidence: The test waits at most 90 seconds for any one-minute candle, then immediately requires a five-minute candle even though the approved plan says to compare it when five minutes are available.
findings.action: Wait for a complete fresh five-minute window with a dedicated timeout, or record only that sub-check as pending until five source minutes exist; never accept an old candle as proof.

findings.summary: Operational separators and missing-value glyphs render as mojibake.
findings.evidence: User-visible literals contain characters such as 'a-with-circumflex/euro/dash' and 'A-with-circumflex/middle-dot' rather than the intended em dash and middle dot.
findings.action: Replace the double-encoded literals with valid UTF-8 glyphs or plain ASCII equivalents and assert the rendered output.
